embeddedCSS.name: normalize.css
embeddedCSS.evidence: Original dist and src/core/_reset.scss header identifies v7.0.0 MIT

adaptations: Extract only the original displayed four-collapsible HTML block, not the duplicated documentation code example. Preserve original labels, filler body text, checkbox/label order and CSS mechanism.
Retain entire original dist CSS except one Google Fonts import; append narrow host layout/focus/reduced/hidden rules. No original collapse geometry/selectors/transitions replaced.
Original Google fonts omitted, original sans-serif fallback retained; font files not embedded. Original dist textual SVG data URLs are text source, not binary packaging.

ID and name prefixed per instance while maintaining required collapsible prefix; labels become keyboard focusable button role with Enter/Space -> actual checkbox.click(), expanded and body hidden ARIA synchronized.

Host title, optional second independent example, reset and lifecycle are authored adapter, not official demo features. Hidden keeps exact DOM/state but pauses transitions; exit removes root and all adapter listeners.

dedup.difference: Plop is controlled sequential status/current step with Lettering/Sticker/filter noise. PaperCSS is four independent checkbox disclosures and original CSS handdrawn framework, no step progression, spring or generated letter noise. Both handdrawn style, not a new handdrawn category.
